newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes Aviation July load factor up.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes Aviation July load factor up.

text.p: Great Lakes Aviation Ltd said its July passenger load factor rose 12.8 percentage points to 57.1 percent from 44.3 percent a year ago.
The improvement in load factor reflects a 42.7 percent decline in revenues passenger miles to 15.7 million and a 55.6 percent drop in available seat miles to 27.5 million.
The company carried 51,119 pasengers in July, a 44.8 percent drop from a year ago.

July 1997 traffic reflects the continued graduated resumption of flying following a voluntary shutdown of scheduled service by the company in May and the elimination of flights in the southeastern United States. It also eliminated flights in Arizona and Sonora, Mexico.
As of July 31, Great Lakes has restored scheduled service to 42 airports in 10 states.
